Plants of the World Online account: Spergularia flaccida (Madden) I.M.Turner.

The native range of this species is Macaronesia, N. Africa to Mauritania, Sicilia (Linosa) to NW. India and NE. Tropical Africa. It is an annual and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.
